scope: local restricted PostgreSQL HTTP diagnostic; sequential calls on one attempt; includes CSRF, authenticate, admission and the unit of work
postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
reliabilityReason: HTTP writes authenticate and admit before the transaction, then revalidate the account inside it. CSRF adds a family lookup when a refresh cookie is present. Save uses separate selection and answer statements because a data-modifying CTE cannot see its own row changes and runtime has no UPDATE on answer selections.
